She stands in a modern, well-lit bathroom, facing a large mirror. She holds a sleek white bottle with gold accents and applies a dollop of cream to her cheeks. (2) She continues to blend the cream into her facial skin using upward strokes with her fingers. The background shows a heated towel rack and neutral stone-textured tiles. She maintains an expressive facial expression while talking towards her reflection. (3) The woman puts on a pair of round, black-framed glasses. She touches her eyebrows and forehead, showing the light white cast of the product. The camera maintains a medium close-up shot, focusing on her upper body and hand movements. (4) A full-screen graphic transition occurs. The screen is light grey with subtle brushstroke textures. It displays the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo, social media handles, telephone numbers, and addresses for locations in Sanchong and Nanjing East Road.
